laws.rule: Valle Nuevo / Juan Bautista Pérez Rancier National Park, Constanza: camping for more than a day requires a Ministry of Environment permit. The tourism ministry says visitors must respect guides and rangers and must not smoke, carry weapons, make noise, leave rubbish, feed or take animals, remove plants, or paint rocks, plants or structures.

items.text: Valle Nuevo / Juan Bautista Pérez Rancier National Park: the tourism ministry visitor rules say no smoking. This is a park rule, not a province-wide tobacco-law review.
